lines.en: Tidereavers, the mark is hiding out at Granheim Abbey, and there's a mountain of gold waitin' to reward his/her bounty!  I don't care if you burn the place to ashes... I want Protagonist's pretty little blue head.
lines.zh: 噬浪海贼们，目标就在格兰海姆修道院，事成之后我们会获得his/her头上堆得像山一样高的赏金 ！我不管你们会不会把这个地方烧成灰……我只想要Protagonist的漂亮小蓝脑袋。

lines.en: Oh my stars...  Look, a baby dragon! What a sweet thing!
lines.zh: 我的天哪…… 看，是一只小龙！太可爱了！

lines.en: Yes, it's scared, too...  What are you doing here, dear dragon??
lines.zh: 是啊，而且它吓坏了…… 可爱的小龙，你在这里做什么？？

lines.en: Tidereavers were probably lookin' to sell it. The grown ups go for a king's ransom, y'know.  No surprise considerin' the devastation they can bring.
lines.zh: 噬浪海贼团可能打算要卖掉它。你要知道，成年龙的价值都够给国王付赎金了。 考虑到它们的破坏力，我一点也不意外。
lines.name: 斯泰凡

lines.en: Sister Diana... please allow me to care for this dragon.
lines.zh: 戴安娜修女……请允许我来照顾这条龙。

lines.en: Of course, Sister Abigayle. This dragon is a lucky one to have you.
lines.zh: 当然，阿比盖尔修女。这条小龙能有你照顾，是它的福气。
lines.name: 戴安娜

lines.en: Oh my stars... that's quite a love bite!  A little softer next time? Maybe I shall call you...  Nibbler!
lines.zh: 我的天哪……这咬的真可爱！ 下次可以轻一点吗？你就叫…… 轻遥吧。
